howItWorksBody.message: When a YouTube Short or Facebook Reel finishes, ReelShift waits for your chosen delay and then moves to the next video. You can turn the extension off at any time.

privacyBody.message: ReelShift stores only your preferences locally in the browser. It does not collect analytics or personal content from videos.
